answer: Here is one concrete wall: Validated nuclear technician clearance with nuclear regulator attestation. It works because a clearance the regulator renews after background checks, and the oasis it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the ember is that the farm's unit economics never work. The timber is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
